meta_description:
7,873 likes, 200 comments - fentybeauty on October 27, 2026: "Sydney showed up ’n out for our Pro Filt’r Fluid Flex Masterclass with @myer + @kaylaaperez_ ! 🇦🇺

A day filled with community, education and shade matching in 3 simple steps:

1. Find your shade family
2. Find your undertone
3. Find your Flex!

With @kaylaaperez_ sharing her pro makeup tips for a flawless Fluid Flex finish from skin prep to the final touches:
💧 @Fentyskin Dew N Plump Hydrating Glow Serum to prep, plump + hydrate
💖 @Fentybeauty Diamond Bomb Veil in ‘Pink Ice’ for an iridescent glow
🔒 @Fentybeauty You Mist Setting Spray for waterproof glam that lasts up to 12 hours longer
✨ @Fentyskin Dew N Plump Mist to rehydrate + refresh the final look

Thank you, Australia! 🫶🏾🫶🏿🫶🏼".
